Manifest.Name: 直接替换 / Quick Replace
Manifest.Author: w7lau
Manifest.Description: 把新滤芯拖到水壶上，或把新电池拖到电器上，直接换下旧的。旧件放回原来的物品栏，放不下就不换。 充电器有空位先放入；放不下时，才换出电量最多且比拖入电池电量更高的一块。 Drag a new filter or battery onto a device to replace the old one. The old item returns to the source inventory; nothing is swapped if it cannot fit. Batteries go into empty charger space first. If there is no room, take the highest-energy battery only if it has more charge than yours.
